title: First Ontario Line TBM 'Libby' Arrives at Future King West Station
summary:
On November 6, the Ontario Ministry of Transportation announced the arrival of the first tunnel boring machine (TBM) at the future King West Station, marking the first time a TBM has reached a station along the future Ontario Line 3.

The first of two TBMs, nicknamed Libby for Liberty Village where the western tunnel launch shaft is located, began its excavation eastward in April 2026. Now, after nearly seven months of tunnelling, the installation of 780 tunnel lining rings, and 1.3 kilometres of progress, Libby broke through to the first underground station of the Ontario Line 3.
